analysis.title: Joby Aviation Inc. (JOBY): 3Q26 First Take: Scaling capacity
key_insights: JOBY 3Q26 revenue of $55.1mn was above FactSet consensus of $39.0mn, while adjusted EBITDA of $(207.9)mn was below consensus of $(189.9)mn.
The company completed eIPP flights in Texas and Florida and scaled manufacturing, with 17 aircraft in production.
JOBY raised FY26 revenue guidance to $135-140mn from $115-125mn prior, against consensus of $123mn.
The company reiterated 2H26 cash usage guidance of $(385)-(415)mn. Free cash flow in 3Q26 was $(193.4)mn.

Goldman rates JOBY Sell with a 12-month price target of $7, based on 4.5X CY30E EV/Sales. The price target implies 38.6% upside from $5.05, and the price target was lowered from $8 in July and $10 in December 2025.

3Q26 revenue grew 144.0% y/y from $22.6mn. Diluted EPS was $(0.22) versus a GS estimate of $(0.24) and $(0.48) in 3Q25. The $49.8mn of other income, net, which GS had at zero, contributed $0.05 of EPS.

market_movers.rationale: Revenue beat and higher FY26 revenue guidance, but adjusted EBITDA missed consensus and 2H26 cash burn guidance of $(385)-(415)mn was reiterated. The 12-month price target rests on 4.5X CY30E EV/Sales.
